answer: Each fake identity must moor one vine anchor at a distinct bend of the river, paying an umber toll to row upstream against the current: the k-th clone pays k tolls, so N fakes cost N(N+1)/2 in total, 55 for 10 and 5,050 for 100. Two vines moored at the same bend tangle and both wash away, so clones cannot share one anchor to split the toll.
